addingCard.title: Adding a card
addingCard.body: On the "Cards" screen, tap "Add card". Choose a place from the list, or add a new one — start typing its name to see suggestions from Google Maps, or just type the name manually. Choose a category too, then a type: "Visit limit" (expiry date optional) or "Unlimited" (expiry date required). You can add a voucher or code right away or later.

visits.title: Logging visits
visits.body: Tap "+" on a card to log a visit with today's date. In the visit history you can later change the date, add a time, and a short note.

expiryArchive.title: Expiry and archive
expiryArchive.body: A card's details show the number of visits used, the expiry date, and the full history. Cards that have expired or been fully used move automatically to "Archive" — from there, one tap adds a new card at the same place.

account.title: Account
account.body: The app works fully without an account. Sign in only if you want the same cards on more than one device.

companies.title: Places
companies.body: The "Places" tab lists the places linked to your cards — mark favorites, sort the list (including "nearest to me", if you share your location), and check which cards you have at each one. You can also add a new place directly from this tab. If a place has a saved location, you'll also see a map on its details page.

paymentsAndBookings.question: Can I pay for a card or book classes in the app?
paymentsAndBookings.answer: No — Karnet.asist only tracks cards you've already paid for. It doesn't handle payments, sales, or class bookings.

deleteConfirm.question: Can a card or visit be deleted by accident?
deleteConfirm.answer: No — deleting always requires confirmation in a separate dialog.

expiryOptional.question: Does a visit-limit card need an expiry date?
expiryOptional.answer: No, it's optional. "Unlimited" cards always require one.

ocr.question: Does the app read card details from a photo?
ocr.answer: Not in this version — you enter the details manually, and can attach a photo or QR code as a file.

mobileApp.question: Is there a phone app?
mobileApp.answer: The app runs as a web app for now. Native Android/iOS versions are planned for a later stage.

onboarding.title: Your cards, always at hand
onboarding.body: Gym, pool, classes, massage, beauty salon — every visit and deadline in one place. No account, no sign-in, no payments.
onboarding.bullet1: A visit counter you can read at a glance
onboarding.bullet2: A reminder before a card runs out
onboarding.bullet3: Your data stays on this phone unless you decide otherwise
